In [[mathematics|mathematical]] [[finite group|finite]] [[group theory]], the '''vertex''' of a representation of a finite group is a subgroup associated to it, that has a special [[group representation|representation]] called a '''source'''.  Vertices and sources were introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Green|year=1958–1959}}.
